summary: Phase 1 backend + frontend verified. 27/27 pytest cases pass covering auth (login/me/wrong password/brute-force lockout), authorization (401 on protected endpoints, tenants restricted), lead creation & Indonesian phone normalization (08/62/+62/8 variants -> 628xxxxxxxxxx, invalid=400, NOT_CHECKED persisted before coverage check), coverage engine (COVERED inside polygon centroid, NOT_COVERED far away, invalid coords=400, lead updated in-place after coverage check with no new lead), GIS status (4 files READY, active, geometry_count>0), GIS upload (invalid .txt gracefully handled, valid GeoJSON polygon -> READY with geometry_count=1), packages public+CRUD, branding PUT. Frontend E2E verified: landing hero CTA opens lead-form-overlay, name+phone submit opens map-container with map-center-pin and map-floating-action-button ('Tentukan Lokasi Saya' initially; becomes 'Cek Coverage' after panning); clicking Cek Coverage triggers /api/coverage/check and shows modal-uncovered-container (panned off coverage). Admin /login redirects to /admin, admin-dashboard rendered, all sidebar nav testids (coverage, packages, leads, branding) clickable, admin-branding-color-picker present.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_leads.py POST /api/leads is public (correct per spec) but has no rate limiting; consider adding IP-based throttle to prevent lead spam.
coverage_service check_coverage may raise generic 500 without logging the exception details—consider logger.exception for observability.
PUT /api/packages requires full PackageBody (all fields); consider PATCH semantics or make fields optional for partial updates.
security.set_auth_cookies uses SameSite=None+Secure (needed for cross-site preview) which is fine but ensure production CSRF protection since cookies are auto-sent.
resolve_tenant falls back to default when subdomain unknown—may hide misconfigured tenants; consider strict mode or 404 when explicit ?subdomain= provided but not found.
seed_data_creation: Test leads with TEST_ prefix created; test packages TEST_pkg created and cleaned up. Uploaded test GeoJSON coverage file was deleted after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Frontend: geolocation is unavailable in headless automation—map's FAB stays 'Tentukan Lokasi Saya' initially, panning transitions state to SET_MANUALLY and FAB becomes 'Cek Coverage'. Default map center (Jombang -7.5457,112.2331) is very close to coverage; a panned point can go NOT_COVERED. To force COVERED, use /api/coverage/public/geometries centroid coords.
